reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 101-110 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 22 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs NOT opened. FRDB snapshot (/tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip, SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) was read after dropping every column containing 'cmax'; arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex, annotated form and application/population comments only. The only source Cmax recorded (clinofibrate frdb_927) was read from the original abstract after its mapping was fixed by AUC. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Every journal original except PMC163478 is closed-access (OpenAlex is_oa=false and no repository copy for all 10 other DOIs; physiology.org, aspetjournals and ScienceDirect returned 403). These were time-boxed to PubMed abstracts plus the ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 records NCT01954589 (ACT-462206) and NCT01469481 (PF-04991532). No browser automation, no account-requiring service, and no user email was sent. IR is not inferred from route; conventional tablets/capsules not worded IR are verified_with_caveat, following the 81-90 convention. Hypericin ruling follows the coordinator's message msg_49f132f3b61f.
unresolved_issues: Amuvatinib (9234): manifest SMILES is AMONAFIDE (FRDB analyte CID 50515), but the source dosed amuvatinib (MP470). Ruled ineligible on identity; the coordinator should confirm the FRDB compound-analyte mapping error.

Sulfabenzamide (275): cited PMID 6663474 is a diflunisal paper; the FRDB row appears to hold diflunisal PK misfiled under sulfacetamide, and the name (sulfabenzamide) and SMILES (sulfacetamide) also disagree. Ruled ineligible.
Hypericin (8696): all 6 arms ruled ineligible as botanical-extract dosing, per the coordinator's direction; FRDB frdb_8642 annotated form (900 mg/750 μg) contradicts its 1500 μg dose.

PF-04620110 (47055): the FRDB value is a WebPlotDigitizer read of the Figure 2E MEDIAN; the study is a postprandial lipid challenge (meal timing unconfirmed); manifest unit 'mg/mL' is implausible. Likely ineligible or at best caveated once the full text is seen.
PF-04991532 (39483): [14C] 450 mg oral suspension ADME study; parent vs total-radioactivity Cmax and fasting are unconfirmed; the FRDB t1/2 of 1898 h is anomalous.
Clinofibrate (418): frdb_927 is verified from the abstract only (unit printed 'μ/ml'); frdb_924-926 (JPBA method paper) need the full text for fasting/formulation.

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: Maciejewski 2013 AJP-GI (PF-04620110), Li 2013 JPBA (clinofibrate dose ranging), Uang 2001 J Chromatogr B (mephenoxalone), Diao 2013 DMD (butylphthalide), Hoch 2014 JCP (ACT-462206), Sharma 2019 Xenobiotica (PF-04991532), Zhang 2011 FCP (meldonium; n per arm).

Formulation (IR tablet vs solution) and population health status (overweight subjects?) not confirmed. Manifest Cmax unit 'mg/mL' is implausible for a 21 mg dose (likely ng/mL) and needs coordinator check.
